title: Apply for refund on a maritime product or service
summary: You can apply for a refund on a maritime product or service if you meet specific criteria.
intro: You can apply for a refund on a maritime product or service:
who_can_apply: Former NSW residents who move interstate, register the vessel in the new state or territory, and wish to claim a refund on the remaining NSW registration.
Interstate acquirers of a NSW-registered vessel who wish to claim a refund on the remaining NSW registration.
what_you_need: Receipt for the product or service (if applicable).
The form Request for refund – Maritime customers only (PDF).
Other supporting documentation relating to the product or service as listed on the form.

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the request for refund form.
Return your form and supporting documentation:

external_links.text: Request for refund – Maritime customers only (PDF)

internal_links.text: Submit a notice of disposal for a vessel

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for a refund?
faqs.a: Former NSW residents who move interstate and register the vessel in the new state or territory, or interstate acquirers of a NSW-registered vessel.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to apply for a refund?
faqs.a: You need a receipt for the product or service (if applicable), the form Request for refund – Maritime customers only, and other supporting documentation listed on the form.

faqs.q: How do I submit my refund application?
faqs.a: First, download and complete the request for refund form. Then, return your form and supporting documentation to the service centre.
